sources.implementationDifference: Own discounted continuing semi-gradient prototype with fixed generic random features, critic traces, clipped TD error, norm-controlled steps and exact gradient of the policy/exploration mixture. No convergence or replication claim.
sources.evidence: Read actor-critic updates and distinction between discounted episodic and average-reward continuing formulations.
sources.title: Sutton and Barto: Reinforcement Learning, second-edition draft

sources.implementationDifference: Future coverage arm uses bounded quantized observation-action counts to select exploratory actions; no density pseudo-count or intrinsic reward reproduction. Preflight uses uniform exploration.
sources.evidence: Read distinction between density and transition models and limitations of exact counts in large state spaces.
sources.title: Unifying Count-Based Exploration and Intrinsic Motivation

hypothesis.rationale: Test the new controller through existing runtime/factory/export/experiment contracts before freezing its implementation. Fixed random features and linear actor/critic are an inexpensive initial representation hypothesis, not Stream-X reproduction.
hypothesis.statement: A mechanic-agnostic online actor-critic executes a continuous thermal-v2 life with isolated evaluation and learns a useful initial behavior before any new challenge is authored.
hypothesis.falsification: Technical failure, non-finite updates, export mismatch or lack of at least 20% thermal MAE improvement over the untrained policy on 2 of 3 seeds means the initial baseline is not established. Do not claim generalization or rank algorithm families. Keep final 100k checkpoint and every seed; no parameter search on the new challenge.

decisionRule: Final100k; all3 complete, isolated inference exports; at least20% MAE improvement over initial on2/3 for baseline established. No generalization claim; diagnose representation/learning if failed.
